FAQ

## Common questions

How the marketplace works for manufacturers and distributors.

Where do the companies come from, and what makes this catalog different?

Alongside the large exporters, the catalog is built around small local and craft producers that the
big transnational marketplaces don't carry: family manufactories, distilleries, apiaries, workshops,
cooperatives and family farms. Each listing is checked against an official government business
registry (SIREN in France, CVR in Denmark, RCCM, and dozens more) or a recognized origin mark like
PDO, GI or Genuine Jersey, and sorted by category and country. That is the difference, unique local
supply you can't find elsewhere, verified at the source and actually findable.

The catalog has thousands of manufacturers, are they real companies?

Yes. Listings are sourced from public trade registries, export databases and verified business
directories across 200+ markets, and every website is checked to be live before a listing goes
public. Each profile shows trust signals you can check yourself, and we plainly mark which companies
are Verified versus listed from public sources. These are real companies, not fabricated entries.

What makes this different from cold outreach or hiring a trade agent?

Three things. First, manufacturers here have published exactly what markets, channels and partner
types they want, so your introduction is expected, not ignored. Second, your distributor profile is
matched against their requirements before you even hit send, so both sides already know it's a fit.
Third, contact details stay private until both parties agree to connect, no spam, no wasted calls.

Is it really free? What's the business model?

Distributors, importers, wholesalers and sales agents use the platform completely free, browse,
build a profile, send introduction requests. Manufacturers can claim their listing and receive
requests for free too. We plan to offer optional paid features for manufacturers who want promoted
placement and advanced reach, but the core marketplace stays free for both sides.

Who can see my contact details and company information?

Your direct contact information, email, phone, address, is never shown publicly. It's only shared
with a specific counterpart after both sides agree to the introduction. Your company profile (name,
location, categories, description) is public and helps the right partners find you.

How quickly can I realistically expect a first connection?

Distributors with a complete profile and a clear target category typically hear back within a few
days of sending their first request. Manufacturers with detailed profiles and active distribution
offers usually receive their first inbound request within 2-4 weeks. Response speed depends on both
sides, we notify immediately by email so nothing sits unseen.

Can I use the platform in my own language?

Yes. The interface is available in 17 languages, use the language switcher on any page. In your
dashboard you can write your profile, offers and product descriptions in your own language and
translate them to English in one click. Catalog content is also shown machine-translated in several
major languages.

# Le Laboratoire spécialisé dans la fabrication de solutions injectables

Depuis plus de 130 ans, les Laboratoires CDM Lavoisier, entreprise pharmaceutique française
indépendante, sont spécialisés dans la mise au point, la fabrication et la distribution de produits
injectables stériles répondant aux dernières réglementations internationales. Nous commercialisons
des médicaments injectables en ampoules, flacons et poches, et des dispositifs médicaux destinés aux
pharmacies d’officines, ainsi qu’aux hôpitaux publics et privés. Au sein de notre site industriel de
La Chaussée Saint Victor, nous fabriquons nos propres produits mais également ceux d’autres acteurs
du secteur.

[Savoir-faire]

## Fabrication et distribution de médicaments sous AMM Lavoisier

CDM Lavoisier dispose d’un portfolio de médicaments injectables couvrant différentes aires
thérapeutiques (nutrition, anesthésie réanimation, traitement de la douleur, etc…). Ces médicaments
sont fabriqués sur notre site de La Chaussée Saint Victor.

[Nos Médicaments][34]
[Façonnage]

## Fabrication de médicaments pour le compte de laboratoires pharmaceutiques et donneurs d’ordre
## publics

Fort de son savoir-faire de plus d’un siècle dans la fabrication de médicaments injectables, CDM
Lavoisier développe et produit de nombreuses solutions injectables pour le compte de tiers dans le
cadre de son activité de façonnage pharmaceutique.

[Façonnage pharmaceutique][35]

### About Conference



After a successful conference of Pharmaceutica 2025, Pharma Conferences team cordially invites
participants from all over the world to attend **"27^{th} International Conference and Exhibition on
Pharmaceutics & Novel Drug Delivery Systems" **slated on August 20-21, 2026 in London, UK .
This [Pharmaceutics Conference][82] includes a wide range of Keynote presentations, Oral talks,
Poster presentations, Symposia, Workshops, Exhibitions and Career development programs.

[Novel drug delivery systems Conference][83] is one of the well-established conference

### About Conference



After a successful conference of Pharmaceutica 2025, Pharma Conferences team cordially invites
participants from all over the world to attend **"27^{th} International Conference and Exhibition on
Pharmaceutics & Novel Drug Delivery Systems" **slated on August 20-21, 2026 in London, UK .
This [Pharmaceutics Conference][82] includes a wide range of Keynote presentations, Oral talks,
Poster presentations, Symposia, Workshops, Exhibitions and Career development programs.

[Novel drug delivery systems Conference][83] is one of the well-established conference
among [Pharmaceutical Conferences][84] organized by Conference Series

Pharmaceutica 2026 covers various aspects of Bio-Pharmaceutics, [Pharmaceutical Chemistry][85], Drug
Targeting and Design, Pharmacokinetics and Pharmacodynamics in Drugs, Pharmaceutical Formulation,
Pharmaceutical Manufacturing, Pharmaceutical Nanotechnology, [Novel Drug Delivery Systems][86],
Smart Drug Delivery Systems, [Nano medicine][87] and Biomedical Applications, Biomaterials in Drug
Delivery, Vaccine Drug Delivery Systems, Medical Devices for [Drug Delivery][88], Biologics
& [Biosimilars][89], Pharmaceutical Analysis, Pharmaceutical Process Validation, Pharmaceutical
Packaging, [Clinical Trials][90] and [Clinical Research][91], Pharmacogenetics and Genomics,
Regulatory Affairs and Intellectual Property Rights, Industrial and Physical Pharmacy, Clinical and
Hospital Pharmacy, [Pharmacovigilance][92] and Drug Safety, Pharmacy Education and Practice

### Sessions & Tracks


**Track 1:** [**Bio-Pharmaceutics**][98]

[Bio Pharmaceutics conferences][99] plays an important role in [drug discovery][100] like drug
disposition, Innovations in clinical development, Pharmaceutical technology, Pharmaceutics and drug
delivery, Drug design, Targeted drug, gene delivery,  [Sustained drug delivery system][101], Routes
of administration, Fundamental drug development.

**Related Associations and Societies**:  International Pharmaceutical Federation | [Pharmaceutical
Group of the European Union][102] |  [The Society of Hospital Pharmacists of
Australia][103] | Canadian Pharmacists Association | Pharmacy in China | Danish Association of
Pharmaconomists | Pharmaceutical Society of Ireland | The Pharmaceutical Association of Israel 

**Track 2: **[**Pharmaceutical Chemistry**][104]

Pharmaceutical Chemistry is the study of drug design to optimize pharmacokinetics and
pharmacodynamics, and synthesis of new drug molecules. [Pharmaceutical Chemistry][105] is a branch
of chemistry that deals with the chemical, biochemical and pharmacological aspects of drugs. It
includes synthesis/isolation, identification, structural elucidation, structural
modification, [structural activity relationship][106] (SAR) studies, and study of the chemical
characteristics, biochemical changes after drug administration and their pharmacological effects as
well as analysis of drugs. In more simple words it is more broader than [medicinal
chemistry][107] in its application also in the fields of analysis, identification, as well as,
structural elucidation of drugs.

**Related Associations and Societies**:  [Pharmaceutical Group of the European
Union][108] | International Pharmaceutical Federation | The Society of Hospital Pharmacists of
Australia |Pharmacy in China | [Danish Association of Pharmaconomists][109]

**Track 3: **[**Drug Targeting and Design**][110]

[Drug design][111], often referred to as [rational drug design][112] or simply rational design, is
the inventive process of finding new medications based on the knowledge of a biological target. The
drug is most commonly an organic small molecule that activates or inhibits the function of a
biomolecule such as a protein, which in turn results in a therapeutic benefit to the patient. In the
most basic sense, drug design involves the design of molecules that are complementary in shape and
charge to the biomolecular target with which they interact and therefore will bind to it. Drug
design frequently but not necessarily relies on computer modeling techniques. This type of modeling
is sometimes referred to as [computer-aided drug design][113]. Finally, drug design that relies on
the knowledge of the three-dimensional structure of the biomolecular target is known as
structure-based drug design. In addition to small molecules, [biopharmaceuticals][114] and
especially therapeutic antibodies are an increasingly important class of drugs and computational
methods for improving the affinity, selectivity, and stability of this protein-based therapeutics
have also been developed.

**Related Associations and Societies**:  International Pharmaceutical Federation | [Pharmaceutical
Group of the European Union][115] |  [The Society of Hospital Pharmacists of
Australia][116] | Canadian Pharmacists Association | Pharmacy in China | Danish Association of
Pharmaconomists | Pharmaceutical Society of Ireland | The Pharmaceutical Association of Israel 

**Track 4: **[**Pharmacokinetics and Pharmacodynamics in Drugs**][117]

Pharmacokinetics is currently defined as the study of the time course of drug absorption,
distribution, metabolism, and excretion. Clinical [pharmacokinetics][118] is the application of
pharmacokinetic principles to the safe and effective therapeutic management of drugs in an
individual patient. Primary goals of clinical pharmacokinetics include enhancing efficacy and
decreasing [toxicity][119] of a patient’s drug therapy. The development of strong correlations
between drug concentrations and their pharmacologic responses has enabled clinicians to apply
pharmacokinetic principles to actual patient situations.

[Pharmacodynamics][120] refers to the relationship between drug concentration at the site of action
and the resulting effect, including the time course and intensity of therapeutic and adverse
effects. The effect of a drug present at the site of action is determined by that drug’s binding
with a receptor.

Pharmacy][121] | International Pharmaceutical Federation | Pharmaceutical Group of the European
Union |  [The Society of Hospital Pharmacists of Australia][1

methods for improving the affinity, selectivity, and stability of this protein-based therapeutics
have also been developed.

**Related Associations and Societies**:  International Pharmaceutical Federation | [Pharmaceutical
Group of the European Union][115] |  [The Society of Hospital Pharmacists of
Australia][116] | Canadian Pharmacists Association | Pharmacy in China | Danish Association of
Pharmaconomists | Pharmaceutical Society of Ireland | The Pharmaceutical Association of Israel 

**Track 4: **[**Pharmacokinetics and Pharmacodynamics in Drugs**][117]

Pharmacokinetics is currently defined as the study of the time course of drug absorption,
distribution, metabolism, and excretion. Clinical [pharmacokinetics][118] is the application of
pharmacokinetic principles to the safe and effective therapeutic management of drugs in an
individual patient. Primary goals of clinical pharmacokinetics include enhancing efficacy and
decreasing [toxicity][119] of a patient’s drug therapy. The development of strong correlations
between drug concentrations and their pharmacologic responses has enabled clinicians to apply
pharmacokinetic principles to actual patient situations.

[Pharmacodynamics][120] refers to the relationship between drug concentration at the site of action
and the resulting effect, including the time course and intensity of therapeutic and adverse
effects. The effect of a drug present at the site of action is determined by that drug’s binding
with a receptor.

Pharmacy][121] | International Pharmaceutical Federation | Pharmaceutical Group of the European
Union |  [The Society of Hospital Pharmacists of Australia][1

# Revolutionizing Drug Delivery Through **Oral Film Technology**

At Nualtis, we leverage science and innovation to improve quality of life. We develop and
manufacture innovative oral thin films to create novel and impactful treatments.

[Contact Us][17]Contact Us
Contact Us
Trusted by

Our Oral Film Technology offers **significant advantages**

Our proprietary film technologies offer significant benefits over traditional dosage forms, creating
better experiences for patients and improved treatment outcome.

Enhanced Bioavailability

Our oral films deliver medications directly through the mucosal lining. This results in faster onset
of action, reduced dosage requirements, and minimized side effects compared to conventional tablets
or capsules.

Systemic Absorption

Intimate and prolonged contact with the oral mucosa allows for systemic absorption of the drug,
thereby reducing first-pass metabolism and limiting stomach exposure. This opens up an oral path of
administration for drugs that cannot be given as a tablet or capsule.

Precision Dosing

The innovative delivery method allows for precise control of drug release rates, enabling customized
therapeutic profiles and reduced dosing frequency for improved patient convenience.

Patient-Friendly Design

Nualtis films dissolve rapidly in the mouth without water, making medication administration easier.
They are easy to carry, discreet, with a pleasant taste. Especially for pediatric patients,
geriatric populations, animals, and those with swallowing difficulties the convenient format
improves treatment adherence.

## Our **product platforms** redefine patient outcomes

At Nualtis, we have been pioneering oral film technologies for over two decades. With unmatched
depth in formulation expertise, Nualtis has emerged as a market leader in oral film development with
over 30 patents just in the US.

[Contact us][18]Contact us
Contact us

## Human Health

Our proprietary VersaFilm® platform forms the foundation of a growing portfolio of human health
products.

## Animal Health

Our VetaFilm (R) platform enables stress-free dosing for animals with palatable, room‑stable films
that slip onto a pet's tongue, removing the fight from dosing and ensuring full therapeutic intake.

## Partnering

We partner with pharma leaders from concept to commercialization. We have an existing portfolio of
products available for licensing deals.

## Transform Your Drug Delivery Approach

Whether you're seeking to differentiate an existing product, want to develop a new product, or
partner with us on our existing portfolio, our team can help enhance your therapeutic offerings
through innovative film technology.

[Contact Us][19]Contact Us
Contact Us

## **Our Services** ensure seamless development and supply from start to finish

From concept to commercial supply, we provide the science, GMP capacity, and regulatory muscle to
bring film‑based products to market worldwide.

## R&D Partnerships

Our scientists co‑design prototypes with your team, run taste‑masking, PK, and stability studies,
and hit milestones backed by data you can take straight to regulators.

## GMP Manufacturing

Our plant is inspected by regulatory authorities and scales from pilot to millions of unit campaigns
under strict cGMP, with full QA release, and serialization support.

## Analytical & Regulatory

In‑house labs deliver method development, validation, and ICH stability, while our regulatory group
authors master files and shepherd submissions through FDA, EMA, and global agencies.

## Dr. Michael Raven, CEO

is the CEO of Nualtis, where he drives the company’s strategic direction and growth. He brings
leadership experience from Bayer Pharmaceuticals, atai Life Sciences, and McKinsey & Company. With
academic training in biotechnology, business, and innovation management, he is focused on advancing
oral film drug delivery and building a high-performing team to improve therapeutic outcomes for
humans and animals.

is Chief Scientific Officer at Nualtis, overseeing oral film formulation and product development.

is Vice President, Quality at Nualtis, leading the company’s Quality organization and regulatory
compliance strategy across development and commercial manufacturing. With over 17 years of

operations, and inspection readiness. Nazim is committed to building scalable, pragmatic quality

safety.

is Business Development Lead and General Counsel at Nualtis. With legal and scientific training, he

### About our parent company

[ [Sekhmet_Logo] ][47]

In May 2022, [Sekhmet Pharmaventures][48] acquired a majority stake in Optimus Drugs Group of
Companies, marking a pivotal step in our evolution.

Sekhmet Pharmaventures Pvt. Ltd. (part of Gamot API Pte Ltd. based in Singapore) was formed by Asian
private equity major PAG, along with Indian private equity firms, CX Partners and Samara Capital.
The three has formed an investment platform called Gamot API Pte. Ltd. based in Singapore, with the
aim to buy stakes in fast-growing pharma companies. Sekhmet Pharmaventures continues to combine
inorganic endeavors together with organic growth activities, in order to form a leading Pharma
platform in the spaces of intermediates, API, Finished Dosage Formulations and CMO & CDMO services.

## Frequently asked questions

What does Optimus do?
Optimus is a leading Contract Development and Manufacturing Organization (CDMO), delivering
comprehensive, end-to-end solutions from clinical development to commercial manufacturing of Key
Starting Materials(KSMs), Regulatory Starting Materials(RSMs), Advanced Intermediates, Drug
Substances and Drug Products to the global innovative biotech and pharmaceutical companies.
In which areas does Optimus specialise?

Optimus specialises in:
* Exclusive development and manufacturing of Late phase Molecules.
* Custom Manufacturing of KSM’s, RSMs and Advanced Intermediates.
* Backward integration of KSM’s / Intermediates
* Development and Manufacturing of Oral Solids / Semi Solids dosage forms

How does Optimus ensure quality and compliance?
Quality is maintained through stringent standards in R&D and manufacturing, supported by strong
regulatory understanding, IP management, and robust process development, validation, and
tech-transfer capabilities.
What is the scale of manufacturing capacity?
Optimus provides flexible manufacturing capacity from gram-scale to multi-tonne production,
supporting efficient and cost-effective scale-up of complex molecules and niche molecules.
Does Optimus support custom API or formulation development?
Yes. With a team of 150+ scientists and advanced facilities, Optimus offers custom process
development, analytical method validation, tech transfer, and commercial scale-up for both drug
substances and drug products.
What are the advantages of partnering with Optimus?
* 20+ years of industry expertise
* Integrated backward manufacturing offering cost advantage
* High-quality R&D for complex and niche molecules
* Global export capability and regulatory readiness
* Focus on innovation, affordability, and excellence
Can Optimus support technology transfer or process validation?
Yes. Our expertise team has extensive experience in both technology transfer from a third party
manufacturing site as well as process validations under strict quality and regulatory frameworks.
How does Optimus handle regulatory compliance and documentation?
All submissions are supported with complete documentation such as ANDA / DMFs / IMPD , technical
packages, validation reports, and CMC data to facilitate multi-market regulatory filings.
Does Optimus offer finished formulations or only APIs?
Optimus offers both drug substance and drug products developed through its dedicated formulation R&D
and manufacturing units.

# To be the leader in innovative drug delivery solutions that transform patient experiences through
# improved convenience and better treatment adherence.

**Making Quality Healthcare Affordable Through Drug Delivery Solutions Focusing On Patient
Convenience and Adherence**

Zim Innovation
Who we are
What we do
How we help you

# An Innovative Pharmaceutical Manufacturer in India

We are a research-driven pharmaceutical company based in India that develops, manufactures, and
supplies differentiated generic products in the oral solid dosage forms, both as pre-formulation
intermediates as well as finished formulations for certain key therapeutic segments. As a vertically
integrated pharmaceutical manufacturer, we offer both pharmaceutical and nutraceutical products.

We have in-house R&D capabilities to offer a range of non-infringing drug delivery solutions based
on process technologies that enable patient compliance thereby reducing the cost of treatment.

[
Know More
[Know More]][72]

# We develop complex generic products & novel drug delivery techniques

We provide a comprehensive range of solutions in India and across the globe from a pharmaceutical
manufacturer, including product conceptualization, development, BE studies, regulatory support for
dossier preparation and submission, product registrations, manufacturing, and supply.

Our offerings encompass differentiated generic products in the form of finished formulations and
pre-formulation intermediates, such as granules, pellets (immediate-release, modified-release,
delayed-release, etc.), taste-masked powders, dry suspensions, tablets, capsules, and Oral Thin
Films (OTF).

[
Know More
[Know More]][73]

# We help our partners gain market-share with our cutting-edge technology

As an experienced pharmaceutical manufacturer,  ZIM Labs uses its proprietary knowledge, technology
and manufacturing process expertise to bridge the technology gap in Regulated, Pharmerging and ROW
markets while assisting local players in various geographies to launch differentiated /combination
generic products to compete in their respective local markets.

[
Know More
[Know More]][74]

## Products

# Technology Based Products

We are a pharmaceutical products manufacturing company, innovating in novel drug delivery solutions,
leveraging cutting-edge technology to deliver maximum benefits to our clients. Backed by an expert
R&D team and state-of-the-art facilities, our vision is to provide niche, affordable, and
high-quality healthcare solutions that ensure patient convenience and adherence.

# To be the leader in innovative drug delivery solutions that transform patient experiences through
# improved convenience and better treatment adherence.

**Making Quality Healthcare Affordable Through Drug Delivery Solutions Focusing On Patient
Convenience and Adherence**

Zim Innovation
Who we are
What we do
How we help you

# An Innovative Pharmaceutical Manufacturer in India

We are a research-driven pharmaceutical company based in India that develops, manufactures, and
supplies differentiated generic products in the oral solid dosage forms, both as pre-formulation
intermediates as well as finished formulations for certain key therapeutic segments. As a vertically
integrated pharmaceutical manufacturer, we offer both pharmaceutical and nutraceutical products.

We have in-house R&D capabilities to offer a range of non-infringing drug delivery solutions based
on process technologies that enable patient compliance thereby reducing the cost of treatment.

[
Know More
[Know More]][72]

# We develop complex generic products & novel drug delivery techniques

We provide a comprehensive range of solutions in India and across the globe from a pharmaceutical
manufacturer, including product conceptualization, development, BE studies, regulatory support for
dossier preparation and submission, product registrations, manufacturing, and supply.

Our offerings encompass differentiated generic products in the form of finished formulations and
pre-formulation intermediates, such as granules, pellets (immediate-release, modified-release,
delayed-release, etc.), taste-masked powders, dry suspensions, tablets, capsules, and Oral Thin
Films (OTF).

[
Know More
[Know More]][73]

# We help our partners gain market-share with our cutting-edge technology

As an experienced pharmaceutical manufacturer,  ZIM Labs uses its proprietary knowledge, technology
and manufacturing process expertise to bridge the technology gap in Regulated, Pharmerging and ROW
markets while assisting local players in various geographies to launch differentiated /combination
generic products to compete in their respective local markets.

[
Know More
[Know More]][74]

## Products

# Technology Based Products

We are a pharmaceutical products manufacturing company, innovating in novel drug delivery solutions,
leveraging cutting-edge technology to deliver maximum benefits to our clients. Backed by an expert
R&D team and state-of-the-art facilities, our vision is to provide niche, affordable, and
high-quality healthcare solutions that ensure patient convenience and adherence.

# Burn Fat.
# Build Muscle.

Experience the strength & cardio workout that delivers results that you can see and feel from the
inside out.

FSA/HSA eligible

## The workout that works out well.

Orangetheory combines full-body strength training with heart-pumping cardio to help you build
strength now, while laying the foundation for long-term health.

In weeks, most members notice the shift: more energy, a better mood, and real momentum. On average,
members lose **8.6% body fat** and gain **2.6% lean muscle** from 18 classes in just 8 weeks.¹ That
kind of progress is why millions of members across 1,500 studios worldwide have chosen Orangetheory
to achieve their fitness goals.

Not your thing after 30 days? No sweat—we’ll refund your money.^{†}

[Woman running on a treadmill.]
[Woman doing a low row with a dumbbell, guided by a coach.]

## More personalized. Less pressure.

You don’t need to be fit to get started. Just show up—we’ve got you. With expert coaching and
OTconnect™ technology, every workout adjusts to your fitness level and your goals. Whether you’re
easing in or pushing hard, we meet you with encouragement and support—not pressure. Every step
forward builds a body—and mindset—that’s stronger than yesterday.

[Learn more about the workout.][39]

## The workout that works for people like you.

OTF has really kept me on track as part of my daily routine. It's one of the best decisions I have
made for myself.

[Brad G.]
Brad G
OTF Midland

I feel encouraged and not intimidated by the coaches, and thanks to the OTconnect performance
monitor, I can go at my own pace and do what works for me.

[Nicole P.]
Nicole P
OTF Waterford

My initial goal was to get moving and increase my energy levels. In the process, I have lost over 20
pounds, lost inches, built muscles, and feel stronger than ever!

[Max D.]
Max D
OTF Royal Palm Beach 

## Start your fitness journey today.

# Burn Fat.
# Build Muscle.

Experience the strength & cardio workout that delivers results that you can see and feel from the
inside out.

FSA/HSA eligible

## The workout that works out well.

Orangetheory combines full-body strength training with heart-pumping cardio to help you build
strength now, while laying the foundation for long-term health.

In weeks, most members notice the shift: more energy, a better mood, and real momentum. On average,
members lose **8.6% body fat** and gain **2.6% lean muscle** from 18 classes in just 8 weeks.¹ That
kind of progress is why millions of members across 1,500 studios worldwide have chosen Orangetheory
to achieve their fitness goals.

Not your thing after 30 days? No sweat—we’ll refund your money.^{†}

[Woman running on a treadmill.]
[Woman doing a low row with a dumbbell, guided by a coach.]

## More personalized. Less pressure.

You don’t need to be fit to get started. Just show up—we’ve got you. With expert coaching and
OTconnect™ technology, every workout adjusts to your fitness level and your goals. Whether you’re
easing in or pushing hard, we meet you with encouragement and support—not pressure. Every step
forward builds a body—and mindset—that’s stronger than yesterday.

[Learn more about the workout.][39]

## The workout that works for people like you.

OTF has really kept me on track as part of my daily routine. It's one of the best decisions I have
made for myself.

[Brad G.]

I feel encouraged and not intimidated by the coaches, and thanks to the OTconnect performance
monitor, I can go at my own pace and do what works for me.

[Nicole P.]
Nicole P
OTF Waterford

My initial goal was to get moving and increase my energy levels. In the process, I have lost over 20
pounds, lost inches, built muscles, and feel stronger than ever!

[Max D.]
Max D
OTF Royal Palm Beach

life for patients with obesity, type 2 diabetes, and cardiovascular and kidney diseases.

[ View All Inflammation & Immunology ][112]

cause of chronic inflammatory diseases at a molecular level

the threat of diseases that were once widespread and oftentimes fatal.

developing a novel drug as it primarily involves in predicting the perfect amount of dosage that is
necessary for an individual to get treated for the specific condition.

[Pharmaceutical research][86] is the process through which potential new medicines are identified.
It involves a wide range of scientific disciplines, including biology, chemistry and pharmacology.
Research Drug development is the process of bringing a new pharmaceutical drug into the market once
a lead compound has been identified through the process of drug discovery. Research and development
used in developing the new series or products or improvement of existing products and services.

* [Controlled Drug Delivery System][97]

* Pharmacotherapeutics

* Chemotherapy

treatment options, while pharmacology studies the positive effects of drugs.

bruchsicheren Polymerbehältern in einem nahtlosen, vollautomatischen aseptischen Prozess bei
gleichzeitig unübertroffener Flexibilität im Behälterdesign.

[**bottelpack-Anlagen**][40] können bis zu 37.500 BFS-Behälter pro Stunde produzieren. Darüber
hinaus sind sie die platzsparendsten [aseptischen Abfüllanlagen][41] auf dem Markt, optimieren
wertvollen Platz im Reinraum und gehören damit zu den effizientesten auf dem Markt.

## BFS-Technologie & bottelpack-Abfüllanlagen

Die [**BFS-Technologie**][39] ermöglicht die Herstellung, Befüllung und Versiegelung von
bruchsicheren Polymerbehältern in einem nahtlosen, vollautomatischen aseptischen Prozess bei
gleichzeitig unübertroffener Flexibilität im Behälterdesign.

[**bottelpack-Anlagen**][40] können bis zu 37.500 BFS-Behälter pro Stunde produzieren. Darüber
hinaus sind sie die platzsparendsten [aseptischen Abfüllanlagen][41] auf dem Markt, optimieren
wertvollen Platz im Reinraum und gehören damit zu den effizientesten auf dem Markt.

## Frequently asked questions

What is Slideshare?

Slideshare is the presentation-sharing platform for anyone looking for slide inspiration, to
showcase their knowledge, or to build on their own ideas. With over 25M+ presentations and 70M+
active users, Slideshare is the place where big ideas live.

Why does Slideshare look different?

Slideshare is stepping into a bold new chapter with a refreshed identity. While the core of what you
love remains the same — access to over 25 million decks, powerful AI tools, and a global network of
70+ million curious minds — Slideshare now carries a cleaner, sharper look. This rebrand emphasizes
our renewed mission: helping people transform their ideas into opportunities. With this fresh
energy, Slideshare continues to be the trusted home for expert insights and standout presentations.
This update is just the beginning, designed to better serve creators and thinkers like you.

Do I need a subscription to access Slideshare?

No subscription is required to access Slideshare — you can still browse, read, and upload content.
However, a subscription gives you additional benefits such as the ability to download presentations
and enjoy an ad-free browsing experience.

What is included in a Slideshare subscription?

A paid subscription includes the following exclusive benefits:
* Download presentations
* Copy and paste text directly from presentations
* Enjoy an ad-free experience
* Complimentary access to millions of documents on Scribd

How do I cancel my subscription?

You can cancel your subscription anytime by visiting your account settings. If you cancel, you'll
continue to have access to your subscription benefits until the remaining time expires.

### Can I start with a 500-box pilot run?

Five hundred 20-count boxes equal 10,000 strips. Five hundred 30-count boxes equal 15,000 strips. We

### Private label or custom?

Private label is the faster route when a proven concept fits. Custom development makes sense when

orally disintegrating film. The intended route and product claims must be confirmed for each
project.

and beta-thalassemia marks a significant expansion for pyruvate kinase (PK) activators. By enhancing
the activity of the wild-type PK enzyme, Aqvesme improves red blood cell health and hemoglobin
levels, offering a potent oral alternative to chronic transfusions for patients regardless of their
specific genetic mutation. This broad indication underscores a major shift in metabolic regulation
therapy, requiring R&D teams to leverage deep structural intelligence to map the competitive
landscape of PK activators and identify future modification opportunities for next-generation
erythroid therapies.

The 2026 BIO International Convention, held June 22-25, 2026 at the San Diego Convention Center,
marked a pivotal moment for the biotechnology industry. With nearly 20,000 attendees from over 76
countries (43% international), the event showcased a resurgent biotech sector characterized by
record-breaking deal activity, accelerated AI adoption, and renewed investor confidence. The
convention's theme, "Driven by Purpose," underscored the industry's commitment to transforming
scientific breakthroughs into life-changing therapies. Notable highlights included a landmark $2.5
billion AI-powered drug discovery collaboration, over $100 billion in M&A activity, approximately
70,000 partnering meetings, and transformative regulatory updates from the FDA and EMA.

### [EHA 2026 | ATG vs PTCY GVHD Prophylaxis Clinical Outcome Analysis Report][20]

Abstract: EHA-7202 Short: LB5009 The question of whether post-transplant cyclophosphamide (PTCy)
should replace anti-thymocyte globulin (ATG/ATLG) as the standard GVHD prophylaxis backbone in
HLA-compatible 10/10 matched unrelated donor (MUD) hematopoietic cell transplantation (HCT) has now
been directly addressed by a large, prospective randomized controlled trial presented at EHA 2026 by
Prof. Johannes Schetelig (Dresden, Germany) and co-investigators including Matthias Stelljes. The
trial — designated the GRAPPA study — concludes that ATG-based prophylaxis retains its
standard-of-care position in this specific setting, with PTCy failing to demonstrate superiority on
the primary composite endpoint. This finding is contextualized against a backdrop of registry data,
meta-analyses, and prior Phase 2/3 evidence that had generated significant debate about PTCy's
potential to displace ATG in the 10/10 MUD context.

countries (43% international), the event showcased a resurgent biotech sector characterized by

Abstract: EHA-7202 Short: LB5009 The question of whether post-transplant cyclophosphamide (PTCy)
should replace anti-thymocyte globulin (ATG/ATLG) as the standard GVHD prophylaxis backbone in
HLA-compatible 10/10 matched unrelated donor (MUD) hematopoietic cell transplantation (HCT) has now
been directly addressed by a large, prospective randomized controlled trial presented at EHA 2026 by
Prof. Johannes Schetelig (Dresden, Germany) and co-investigators including Matthias Stelljes. The
trial — designated the GRAPPA study — concludes that ATG-based prophylaxis retains its
standard-of-care position in this specific setting, with PTCy failing to demonstrate superiority on
the primary composite endpoint. This finding is contextualized against a backdrop of registry data,
meta-analyses, and prior Phase 2/3 evidence that had generated significant debate about PTCy's
potential to displace ATG in the 10/10 MUD context.

22 January 2026
The FDA’s recent approval of Aqvesme (mitapivat) for the treatment of anemia in adults with alpha-
and beta-thalassemia marks a significant expansion for pyruvate kinase (PK) activators. By enhancing
the activity of the wild-type PK enzyme, Aqvesme improves red blood cell health and hemoglobin
levels, offering a potent oral alternative to chronic transfusions for patients regardless of their
specific genetic mutation. This broad indication underscores a major shift in metabolic regulation
therapy, requiring R&D teams to leverage deep structural intelligence to map the competitive
landscape of PK activators and identify future modification opportunities for next-generation
erythroid therapies.

## [**Taj Pharmaceuticals**][121], is a [generics pharmaceuticals company][122] with product range
## exceeding 4600 compositions under all therapeutic categories

Taj Pharmaceuticals Limited stands at the forefront of healthcare innovation and compassion. Our
commitment to improving lives is unwavering, as evidenced by our extensive range of pharmaceutical
offerings. We proudly supply prescription solutions, life-saving medications, anti-cancer
treatments, veterinary care products, trusted consumer brands, and cutting-edge CNS drugs.

Our focus extends to a wide spectrum of health concerns, including anemia, anxiety disorders, cancer
and oncology, ear infections, heart failure, hepatitis, HIV/AIDS, influenza, non-Hodgkin’s lymphoma,
obesity, osteoporosis, Parkinson’s disease, pneumonia, transplantation, and various common ailments.

With our headquarters nestled in the vibrant city of Mumbai, India, Taj Pharmaceuticals India
Business continues to lead the way in providing healthcare solutions that empower individuals and
communities to thrive. Join us on our journey towards a healthier, brighter future.

Taj Pharmaceuticals stands proudly as a global leader in generics, ranking among the top ten
pharmaceutical companies in India. Our legacy in the field of medicine spans over a century, and our
commitment to innovation and excellence shines through. We have taken the forefront in critical
therapeutic areas such as cancer, virology, and transplantation. What sets us apart is the
harmonious fusion of Taj Pharma’s generic and pharmaceutical divisions, backed by cutting-edge
genetic sciences, allowing us to craft personalized healthcare solutions tailored precisely to
individual patient needs.

At Taj Pharmaceuticals, our mission is clear – to alleviate suffering and elevate the quality of
life for people worldwide. We have tirelessly pursued this noble goal with unwavering patience,
dedication, imagination, and expertise. Our vision revolves around the creation of targeted
medicines and diagnostic tools, uniting to provide patients, physicians, and payers with superior,
safer, and more cost-effective healthcare solutions.

Welcome to Taj Pharmaceuticals, where a profound vision transforms into reality. We are more than
just a company; we are pioneers in Innovating Generics Healthcare.

Taj Pharmaceuticals Limited operates with an unshakable commitment to earn the trust of doctors,
patients, and customers every single day. We understand that trust is a precious currency, and we
invest daily in becoming champions for our stakeholders.

Over the past decade, Taj Pharmaceuticals Group has been diligently shaping a new paradigm in
healthcare. Throughout our organization in India, we nurture enduring relationships founded on
mutual confidence. This commitment is evident in our actions – our scientists earn trust through
groundbreaking discoveries, our sales and marketing teams work tirelessly to improve global health,
and our colleagues at every level strive to be trustworthy.

This journey demands relentless effort, impeccable execution, unwavering integrity, and transparency
from all Taj Pharmaceuticals Group members. Our global team remains resolute in expanding innovative
treatments and increasing access to quality healthcare worldwide. We aspire to excellence in three
core areas: our people, our products, and our processes.

The fruits of our labor are beginning to emerge, but we believe the best is yet to come. True
champions never relent; they tirelessly pursue better outcomes. As a healthcare company, our purpose
is to help people worldwide live better and longer lives.

Our product range encompasses a wide array of major generic drugs, spanning therapeutic categories
such as anti-cancer drugs, CNS medications, and key medicines for conditions like anemia, anxiety
disorders, heart failure, hepatitis, HIV/AIDS, and more. Taj Pharmaceuticals is dedicated to
improving the human condition by providing effective solutions for common diseases and complex
medical challenges.

###  TAJ PHARMA MANUFACTURING

Our world class finished dosage manufacturing facility is located at At Village – Kalgam,Coastal
Highway Road,Dist. – Valsad, Gujrat – 396142.India in the middle of the some of the major generic
players of the world. The facility has dedicated manufacturing modules for oral solid dosages
Tablet, Capsule, Small Volume Parenterals, Injection, Dry Injection, Syrups & Suspensions ,
Ointments , Dry Syrups and caters to export and domestic markets.
* A Scale up and a Commercial module for Solid dosages
* Two Modules for Sterile manufacturing
* Class 10,000 and Class 1000 controlled conditions. 17 dedicated AHUs to control individual areas.
  Terminal Hepa filters in core processing area

Some of salient features of our facilities are
• Class 10,000 and Class 1000 controlled conditions. 17 dedicated AHUs to control individual areas.
Terminal Hepa filters in core processing area
• Capable of wet/dry granulation, direct compression, film coating and blister/strip/alu-alu packing
• The Purified Water Distribution loop confirming to USP only
• Comprehensive utilities (Boilers, Chilled & Hot water, Air compressors, H.T Electricity incl. DG
and UPS)
• GCs, HPLCs with PDA, UV Spectrophotometers, IR, PSD, DSC
• Absolute focus on Safety, Health & Environment
• Gearing up for ISO 9001 and 14001 (EMS) certifications
• Factory cGMP, WHO, UKMHRA Approved

### Taj Pharmaceuticals Ltd has it's manufacturing facility for the below mention categories of
### pharmaceutical products.

Tablet 22 lac per shift Capsule 22 lac per shift Injection 2.5 lac per shift Dry Injection 3.5 lac
per shift Small Volume Parenterals 4.5 lac per shift Syrups & Suspensions 1.5 lac per shift
Ointments 2.5 lac per shift Dry Syrups 1.5 lac per shift
Manufacturing (Capacity)

[[flask][flask]][123]State-of-the art Liquid Injections (SVP Line) and General Dry Powder
facilities, which adhere to stringent specifications of GMP and WHO-GMP; We are International
standard contract manufacturing Organization.

[[spinner][spinner]][124]Taj Pharma leverages its India units as cost effective manufacturing
together with its extensive expertise and technology platforms to offer competitive, high quality,
custom manufacturing services to a global clientele. Our facility has been inspected by various
international regulators including the USFDA, GMP, WHO & ISO Certified.

[[clock][clock]][125]Taj Pharma’s manufacturing facilities operate to the highest standards of
quality control. Tests produced at all four of our sites are manufactured to stringent levels of
reliability, reproducibility and stability.

> Once again, welcome to [Taj Pharmaceuticals][126], a great company that is translating a great
> vision of generics into reality – We Innovate Generics Healthcare.

[Innovation Excellence]

[Innovation Excellence][14]
[Zydus Srishti]

# Living our mission of creating healthier, happier communities globally

[Zydus Srishti][15]

## Over 29000 people impacting lives across the world

Zydus group is headquartered in Ahmedabad, India, and ranks 4th in the Indian pharmaceutical
industry. The group has manufacturing sites and research facilities spread across five states of
Gujarat, Maharashtra, Goa, Himachal Pradesh and Sikkim in India and in the US and Brazil.

Zydus’ global business has a strong presence in the regulated markets of the US, Europe (France and
Spain) and in the high profile markets of Latin America and South Africa. It is also present in a
big way in 25 other emerging markets worldwide.

## Where Innovation Shapes Healthcare Solutions

**Zydus’ Innovation programme** is spearheaded by **1500 researchers** across 19 sites, working on
differentiated medicines for the future.
From NCEs to vaccines, biosimilars and niche technologies, the group is exploring
different ideas and concepts, innovating constantly.

## Major Areas of Research

[NCE Research] **NCE Research**
* Cardio-Metabolic
* Inflammation and Immunology,
* Neurosciences, Oncology, Rare Diseases
[Biologics] **Biologics**
* Biosimilar Therapeutic proteins
* Biosimilar Monoclonal antibodies
* Biobetters and Novel biologics
[Vaccines] **Vaccines**
* Infectious diseases
[View More][20]

## Innovation that bridges unmet healthcare needs.

[[Tablets]][21]
[

#### Twinrab^{TM} : A Breakthrough innovation in rabies PEP

World’s First Novel Rabies Monoclonal Antibodies (mAbs) cocktail containing Docaravimab and
Miromavimab, providing dual protection against rabies.

][22]
[Saroglitazar Tablets]

#### Lipaglyn - Novel drug to treat diabetic dyslipidemia, a global, unmet healthcare need.

The first NCE from an Indian research pipeline to move from the lab to the market.

[Adalimumab]

#### [Exemptia - The world’s first biosimilar of Adalimumab, the largest selling therapy globally
#### for treating auto immune disorders.][23]

Provides a new lease of life to Indian patients of inflammatory arthritis, who did not have access
to this revolutionary therapy, so far.

[VaxiFlu-4]

#### Vaxiflu-4 - India’s 1st Tetravalent Inactivated Influenza vaccine.

The vaccine provides protection from the four influenza viruses- H1N1, H3N2, Type B (Brisbane) and
Type B (Phuket).

## State-of-the-art manufacturing capabilities.

[Manufacturing]

As one of the key players amongst the pharmaceutical manufacturing companies, the group has
manufacturing capabilities across the entire pharmaceutical value chain: including formulations,
APIs, vaccines, biosimilars, complex products (transdermals, topical etc.), animal health products
and wellness products. It has more than 30 manufacturing plants worldwide including India, Brazil
and USA.

[View More][24]

Miromavimab, providing dual protection against rabies.

][22]
[Saroglitazar Tablets]

#### Lipaglyn - Novel drug to treat diabetic dyslipidemia, a global, unmet healthcare need.

The first NCE from an Indian research pipeline to move from the lab to the market.

[Adalimumab]

#### [Exemptia - The world’s first biosimilar of Adalimumab, the largest selling therapy globally
#### for treating auto immune disorders.][23]

Provides a new lease of life to Indian patients of inflammatory arthritis, who did not have access
to this revolutionary therapy, so far.

[VaxiFlu-4]

#### Vaxiflu-4 - India’s 1st Tetravalent Inactivated Influenza vaccine.

The vaccine provides protection from the four influenza viruses- H1N1, H3N2, Type B (Brisbane) and
Type B (Phuket).
